mission_prompt: Enterprise RFP Proposal & Pricing Factory: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Load the uploaded RFP document (if available) or prompt the user to provide it. Parse the text into a structured tabular format capturing sections, subsections, and key clauses for downstream analysis.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A structured dataset (e.g., JSON or CSV) containing RFP sections, titles, and raw text ready for extraction.

units.description: Analyze the structured RFP dataset to identify all mandatory technical compliance requirements (e.g., security controls, data residency, auditability). Produce a list of criteria with source references.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A table of mandatory compliance criteria, each linked to its location in the RFP.

units.description: Using industry benchmarks and the extracted criteria, create a multi‑tier labor pricing model (e.g., Tier A: senior architects, Tier B: mid‑level engineers, Tier C: support staff). Include hourly rates, estimated effort per compliance item, and total cost projections.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A pricing matrix with labor tiers, rates, effort estimates, and aggregated cost totals.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
units.description: Synthesize the RFP summary, compliance mapping, and pricing model into a polished executive proposal. Include a traceability matrix linking each compliance criterion to the proposed solution component and labor tier.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t3]
units.output_contract: A complete proposal document (text or markdown) with sections: Executive Summary, Technical Approach, Compliance Traceability Matrix, Pricing Overview, and Appendices.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP, including extraction of mandatory technical compliance criteria, multi‑tier labor pricing model, and a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The request requires multiple analytical steps: ingesting the RFP content, extracting compliance requirements, modeling pricing tiers, and synthesizing an executive proposal with traceability. Each step builds on the previous one, so we decompose into four sequential tasks using appropriate skills for data ingestion, analysis, and synthesis.

tasks.name: Ingest & Structure RFP Content
tasks.description: Load the uploaded RFP document (if available) or prompt the user to provide it. Parse the text into a structured tabular format capturing sections, subsections, and key clauses for downstream analysis.
tasks.expected_output: A structured dataset (e.g., JSON or CSV) containing RFP sections, titles, and raw text ready for extraction.

tasks.name: Extract Mandatory Technical Compliance Criteria
tasks.description: Analyze the structured RFP dataset to identify all mandatory technical compliance requirements (e.g., security controls, data residency, auditability). Produce a list of criteria with source references.
tasks.expected_output: A table of mandatory compliance criteria, each linked to its location in the RFP.

tasks.name: Model Multi‑Tier Labor Pricing
tasks.description: Using industry benchmarks and the extracted criteria, create a multi‑tier labor pricing model (e.g., Tier A: senior architects, Tier B: mid‑level engineers, Tier C: support staff). Include hourly rates, estimated effort per compliance item, and total cost projections.
tasks.expected_output: A pricing matrix with labor tiers, rates, effort estimates, and aggregated cost totals.

tasks.name: Generate Executive Proposal with Traceability Matrix
tasks.description: Synthesize the RFP summary, compliance mapping, and pricing model into a polished executive proposal. Include a traceability matrix linking each compliance criterion to the proposed solution component and labor tier.
tasks.expected_output: A complete proposal document (text or markdown) with sections: Executive Summary, Technical Approach, Compliance Traceability Matrix, Pricing Overview, and Appendices.
